newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Socialists choose their candidates for elections.
newsitem.headline: Socialists choose their candidates for elections.

text.p: The Socialist Group, the European Parliament's biggest, on Thursday selected seven candidates for next Tuesday's elections for the assembly's 14 vice presidencies.
They are Paraskevas Avgerinos of Greece, Magdalene Hoff of Germany, Renzo Imbeni of Italy, Luis Marinho of Portugal, Britain's David Martin, Nicole Pery of France and Josep Verde of Spain.
It also proposed that Pertti Paasio, who leads the Finnish social democrat delegation in the Parliament, be elected as one of the five quaestors, who oversee the MEP's financial interests.
"We are delighted to put forward the nomination of a member from a new delegation and a new member state for election to the college of quaestors," Socialist leader Pauline Green said in a statement.
The other Socialist quaestor proposed would be Britain's Richard Balfe.
The elections will take place next Tuesday in Strasbourg.
Under a deal between the Socialists and the European People's Party, Spain's Jose Gil-Robles Del-Delgado is certain to be elected president.
